about.value: Buckhorn Ranch sits on 1,700 high-fenced acres in the Arbuckle Mountains outside Sulphur, Oklahoma. From the moment you arrive at the gate, we handle everything — morning calls, field prep, meal service, and trophies scored and packaged for shipment.

body.value: Included: field preparation of any trophy for shipment, lodging, accommodations, food and beverages. Not included: Oklahoma license and tag fees, transportation to the lodge, gratuity. A wounded animal is charged the same as a kill -- we will do our best to recover it. Whitetail season runs October through December; dates are subject to availability. Exotics are available year round.
